Alger, 31 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 31, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Swedish publisher Snapbreak Games presented its new products during the Mobile Premiere event on October 28, 2026. These five titles, designed by different partner studios, will appear on Android and iOS throughout 2027.
Lors de l'édition inaugurale de l'événem: During the inaugural edition of the Mobile Premiere event, held live on October 28, 2026, video game publisher Snapbreak Games presented its release schedule for the year 2027. The list features five distinct titles, each designed by a different studio, illustrating a wide variety of genres ranging from puzzle to management or strategic card game.
Le premier jeu, Planet of Lana II: Child: The first game, Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf, is a wordless narrative adventure that continues the original story on the planet Novo. Already accessible in advance on the Android platform and available for pre-order on iOS, it offers a six to eight hour experience. Its global launch is scheduled for the end of January 2027.
Dans un style plus sombre, Cages: Hidden: In a darker style, Cages: Hidden Worlds offers a first-person escape room adventure set in an ancient circus of curiosities. This title focuses on solving complex mechanical puzzles and will arrive on Android and iOS in the second quarter of 2027. At the same time, the publisher will release Leafy Corner, a plant shop simulation game inviting you to grow more than a hundred different plant varieties, without time constraints.
L'année 2027 verra également l'arrivée d: The year 2027 will also see the arrival of Hearth and Hamlet, a pixel art city-builder focused on the gradual construction of a medieval kingdom. Finally, the StarVaders title will combine roguelike mechanics, deck building with more than 400 cards and turn-based tactics. The latter is expected by the end of the first quarter of 2027.
